metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 186.

article.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 186.
article.content: The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty equal to the sum received by him in contravention of the provisions of section 186.
article.html:
451Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 186.

Section 451 · Chapter XXI · page 537 of the Act

The Assessing Officer may impose on a person, a penalty equal to the sum received by him in contravention of the provisions of section 186.
